subject: maths
question: If the marked price is 75% more than the cost price and a discount of 40% is allowed on the marked price, then the percentage profit is:
solution:
Given:

The marked price of an article is 75% more than its cost price.

Discount = 40%

Formula used:

Selling Price = Marked Price × (100 - Discount%)/100

Calculation:

Let the Cost price be Rs. 100

The marked price of an article is 50% more than its cost price.

⇒ Marked price = 100 × (100 + 75)/100

⇒ Rs. 175

If a 40% discount

Selling price = 175 × (100 - 40)/100

⇒ S.P = 15 × 7

⇒ Rs. 105

According to the questions,

Profit % = (105 - 100)/100

⇒ 5%

∴ The profit percentage will be 5%.
